caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, symmetrical architectural structure reminiscent of a gothic or cathedral-like setting, with vertical panels featuring pointed arches, lattice patterns, and decorative detailing primarily in shades of grey and accented with green and small touches of brown. The main section contains a large circular medallion at the center, framing an image of a train station or railway with tracks leading to a central building, rendered in muted greens and greys. Below the medallion is an arched opening showing an interior room, where three people are seated around a table, all dressed in green and white period clothing. Flanking the arched opening are two statues or figures standing in niches, each holding a shield or plaque. The entire composition is enclosed within a rectangular border, and the artist's signature “N. Acampora 1937” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Wall Paper and Border
